description: This bar chart illustrates token ratios for different models across several evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled “PT-EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the token ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, marked with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each category features a grouped set of three bars representing different models: “RedWhale (our)” in dark blue, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” in light blue, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” in gray. For “PT-EVAL”, the "RedWhale" bar has a height of approximately 0.42, "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" is approximately 0.52, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” reaches 0.46. In the “KoBEST-CP” category, the bars have heights of 0.79, 0.56, and 0.74 for “RedWhale”, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0”, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” respectively. The “AVG” category shows bars with heights of approximately 0.69, 0.59, and 0.61. No bars are visibly emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
